data.description:
Add `date` as a first-class form field type. Operator decision, 2026-08-11, from
exercising the live site: the Hotel and Travel Reservations task asks for an
**Arrival date** and a **Departure date** and both are free-text boxes.

## Why

`scripts/seed/event.ts:316-317` seeds them as `short_text`:

    ["arrival_date", "Arrival date", "short_text", 1, 0],
    ["departure_date", "Departure date", "short_text", 1, 1],

Not an oversight in the seed — **the system has no date type to choose.** The
schema's CHECK constraint (`migrations/0001_init.sql:252-257`) allows exactly
`short_text, long_text, single_select, multi_select, url, email, file, number`.

So a speaker types their travel dates as prose, and the organizer holding a hotel
block receives strings like "the 14th" and "Tues morning" that nothing can sort,
compare, or export. This is squarely the post-acceptance workflow Marquee claims
as its moat over Sessionize, and it is on the walkthrough path.

## Scope — end to end, one PR

1. **Schema.** Widen the `form_fields.type` CHECK to include `date`. SQLite/D1
   cannot alter a CHECK in place: write a new migration that rebuilds the table
   (create new, copy, drop, rename) following whatever pattern
   `migrations/0002_venue_geography.sql` establishes for this project. Preserve
   every row, index, and foreign key. Verify against a real migrate run, not just
   a read of the SQL.
2. **Route validation.** Add `date` to the zod enums — `src/routes/forms.routes.ts`
   (two places, ~lines 69 and 150) and `src/routes/public-form.routes.ts:61`.
   Search for others; do not assume three is all of them.
3. **Validation and conditions.** `src/lib/form-conditions.ts` switches on field
   type (~lines 196, 215, 246, 287). Give `date` correct coercion and comparison
   semantics. Store and compare as **ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`** — a date with no time and
   no zone, because "the day I arrive" is not an instant. Reject malformed values
   server-side; never trust the client control.
4. **Renderers.** Emit `<input type="date">` wherever fields render: the speaker
   portal (`src/ui/portal/PortalPage.tsx`, the `form` task kind) and the public
   form renderer. Keep the existing label/help-text/required treatment.
5. **Form builder.** `src/ui/forms/FormsPage.tsx` — add `date` to the `FieldType`
   union (line 11) and to the type picker options (~line 80) as "Date", so an
   organizer can actually choose it. Check `hasTextRules` (line 141) and the other
   type-conditional rule blocks and make sure `date` lands in the right bucket
   rather than silently inheriting text rules.
6. **Seed.** Switch `arrival_date` and `departure_date` to the new type. Sweep the
   seed for any other field that is semantically a date and convert it too.
7. **Existing data.** Decide and state what happens to `short_text` values already
   stored for these fields in a seeded/deployed database — convert what parses,
   leave what does not, or re-seed. The demo database is the one that matters here;
   say what you did in the PR.

## Constraints

- **Don't gold-plate.** No date *ranges*, no time-of-day, no timezone picker, no
  calendar widget of our own — the native control is correct and accessible.
- The organizer's language, per `PHILOSOPHY.md`: the picker says "Date", not
  "ISO 8601".
- Flight Deck aesthetic per `DESIGN.md`. A native date input needs styling to sit
  with the other fields in both the portal and the public form — reuse the existing
  field classes; the control must not be visibly taller or shorter than its
  neighbours (**elements never jump**).
- Suite budget 45s, gate budget 120s.

## Acceptance

- An organizer creating a form field can pick **Date** and save it.
- A speaker opening Hotel and Travel Reservations gets a real date picker for both
  arrival and departure, and the saved value round-trips on reload.
- A malformed date submitted directly to the API is rejected with a clear error.
- Conditional logic keyed on a date field behaves correctly.
- Migration applies cleanly to a database with existing form fields and rows, with
  no data loss.
- Validated on the **live deployed site** at https://marquee.stage11.dev as a
  speaker, screenshot in the PR.
- `npm test` green within budget; PR open against `Stage-11-Agentics/marquee` `main`.
data.title: No date field type exists — travel dates are collected as free text

data.body: Plan written: preserve the unrelated dirty MRQ-93 checkout, implement on a clean github/main-derived branch, rebuild form_fields plus submission_answers to preserve rows/indexes/FKs, strictly canonicalize ISO dates, update every registry/renderer/seed, prove a real migrate with existing rows, validate the live speaker flow with screenshot, then open a GitHub PR.
Baseline on clean mrq-95-date at 7304bc6: npm ci completed; npm test passed 78 files / 494 tests in 26.609s, within the 45s suite budget. Missing secret warnings are expected; no baseline failures.

Operator correction incorporated after reading DEPLOY.md: no deploy and no live-site validation. Validate the actual speaker flow locally via c11 browser, capture the local screenshot, read live only as a read-only baseline if useful, and state in the PR that deployment remains pending after human merge.

Brief correction sent to this delegator (2026-08-11): there is no auto-deploy on
this project — merging does not ship (see the new `DEPLOY.md`). My original boot
brief told every delegator to "validate against the live deployed site", which was
wrong: an unmerged branch is not on marquee.stage11.dev, and six delegators each
deploying their own branch to the judge-facing site the day before the deadline
would trample each other.

Standing rule for this ticket: validate **locally** with browser automation, read
the live site only to reproduce the original defect, and state in the PR that the
change still needs a deploy to reach production. Do not run `wrangler deploy`.

Implementation and local runtime evidence: bbfc157 (62e77a1 source plus c11 screenshot artifact). npm test passed 78 files / 497 tests in 36.319s. Wrangler local D1 applied 0001-0008; schema-verify passed 48 tables, 120 indexes, 91 FKs, 3 triggers; legacy-row replay preserved prose and foreign_key_check passed. c11 embedded browser on local port 8895: speaker Hotel and Travel Reservations rendered two native date inputs, saved 2026-10-12/2026-10-14, completed, and values round-tripped after reload; organizer added and saved a Date field and reload retained it; public hotel form rendered two date inputs. Screenshot is artifacts/mrq-95-local-speaker-date.png. No deploy/live-site validation performed per DEPLOY.md/operator correction; deployment remains pending after human merge.

PR #47 is open at https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/marquee/pull/47 (head ae0c088f860a, base github/main 9e1636c3c76c). Exact-head pr-gate passed: 78 files / 500 tests all passing, API/design/types/build/AC trace passed; suite timing warned at 81.831s under concurrent fleet load, while clean pre-rebase MRQ run was 36.319s. Local c11 browser evidence and screenshot are in artifacts/mrq-95-local-speaker-date.png. No live-site validation or deploy was performed per DEPLOY.md/operator correction; human merge and deploy-owner shipment remain pending.
Merged to main (squash). Suite green on merged main: 101 pass, 27.8s, hermetic.

Merge review: diff confined to ticket scope (date field type, migration 0008, condition evaluator, form UI + tests). Conflict-simulated against the rest of the open queue; clean except cli/api-registry.json vs MRQ-96, which MRQ-96 is rebasing. Full suite green on merged main: 101 pass, 27.8s, hermetic. Migration 0008_form_field_dates.sql ships with this — next deploy needs 'wrangler d1 migrations apply'.
